enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Keep the blanket on. Turn onto the back. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Keep eyes closed. Turn onto the back again. Stretch the legs. Remain lying on the bed. Keep sleeping until the alarm rings.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Press the phone alarm to stop it. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Rinse the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back. Walk back to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe. Take out the work clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast and making a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Put the eggs into a pot. Turn on the induction cooker. Boil the eggs. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Take a plate from the cabinet. Take a mug from the cabinet. Take out a tea bag. Put the tea bag into the mug. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water. Put the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch. Wait for the water to boil. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Peel the boiled eggs. Sit down at the table. Eat the toast and eggs. Pour the hot water into the mug. Steep the tea bag. Drink the tea. Stand up. Put the plate and mug into the sink. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag and reviewing the day's patient notes on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Open the bag zipper. Put the laptop into the bag. Put the notebook into the bag. Put the pen into the bag. Put the water bottle into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the phone screen to unlock it. Open the notes application. Scroll through the patient list. Read the patient notes. Scroll down to the next patient. Read the treatment plan. Lock the phone screen. Put the phone into the pocket. Pick up the bag. Put the bag on the shoulder. Turn off the bedroom light. Walk out of the bedroom. Close the bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the apartment. Close the front door. Lock the door with the key. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk out of the building. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out. Check the bus arrival time on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand near the door. Get off the bus at the hospital stop. Walk to the hospital entrance. Push the glass door open. Walk to the changing room. Open the locker. Put the bag into the locker. Take out the work badge. Hang the badge around the neck. Close the locker. Walk to the physiotherapy department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist, assessing and treating patients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the treatment room. Turn on the room light. Open the computer. Log in with the work account. Open the patient list. Call the first patient's name. Greet the patient. Ask the patient about the pain level. Ask the patient to sit on the treatment bed. Bend the patient's knee. Measure the range of motion. Write the measurements into the computer. Apply the ultrasound therapy device to the patient's shoulder. Adjust the device timer. Turn off the device. Ask the patient to stand up. Demonstrate a stretching exercise. Watch the patient perform the exercise. Correct the patient's posture with hands. Guide the patient back to the ward. Walk to the next patient's bed. Adjust the bed height with the foot pedal. Help the patient sit up. Support the patient's arm. Assist the patient to walk along the parallel bars. Record the walking distance on the clipboard. Walk back to the desk. Type the treatment notes into the computer. Save the file. Print the exercise sheet. Hand the exercise sheet to the patient. Say goodbye to the patient. Walk to the nurses' station. Discuss the schedule with the nurse. Walk back to the treatment room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff canteen. Pick up a tray. Take a plate of food. Take a bowl of soup. Take a cup of water. Walk to an empty table. Put the tray on the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and vegetables. Pick up the spoon. Drink the soup. Drink the water. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return station. Put the plate and bowl on the return shelf. Walk out of the canteen. Walk to the restroom. Wash hands with soap. Dry hands with a paper towel. Walk back toward the physiotherapy department.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing physiotherapy sessions, discharge planning, and clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the treatment room. Turn on the computer. Open the patient schedule. Call the next patient's name. Guide the patient to the treatment bed. Ask the patient to lie down. Place a pillow under the patient's knee. Apply manual pressure to the thigh muscle. Ask the patient to contract the muscle. Count the repetitions aloud. Ask the patient to relax. Pick up the gait belt. Wrap the gait belt around the patient's waist. Help the patient stand up. Walk beside the patient down the corridor. Count the steps. Guide the patient back to the bed. Remove the gait belt. Walk to the desk. Open the discharge planning form. Fill in the patient's name and date. Type the functional assessment scores. Print the discharge summary. Staple the pages. Walk to the ward. Hand the discharge summary to the nurse. Sign the discharge form. Walk back to the desk. File the paper copy into the folder. Update the electronic patient record. Save the record. Log out of the computer. Turn off the computer. Walk to the locker. Open the locker. Take out the bag. Close the locker. Walk out of the department.

Walk out of the hospital building. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus timetable on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on an empty seat. Put the bag on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up when the stop is announced. Step off the bus. Walk to the apartment building. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the front door. Take out the key. Unlock the door. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door. Take off the shoes. Put on the slippers. Put the bag on the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Turn on the tap. Wash the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put the pieces into a bowl. Put the chicken on the cutting board. Cut the chicken into pieces. Turn on the range hood. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the chicken into the pan. Stir the chicken with the spatula. Add the vegetables into the pan. Add salt and soy sauce. Stir the food again. Turn off the induction cooker. Turn off the range hood. Take a plate from the cabinet. Put the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the rice and the dishes. Drink the water. Stand up. Carry the plate and bowl to the sink. Rinse the plate and bowl. Put them into the dishwasher. Press the dishwasher start button. Wipe the table with a cloth. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the bathroom fan. Turn on the water heater. Wait for the water to heat. Open the shower door. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature with the handle. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Wrap the towel around the body. Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe. Take out the t-shirt and sweatpants. Put on the t-shirt. Put on the sweatpants. Hang the towel on the rack. Walk back to the bathroom. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the fan. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote. Sit down on the sofa. Put the feet on the footstool. Press the channel button on the remote. Watch the news program. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Scroll through the messages. Put the phone on the sofa armrest. Press the volume button on the remote. Watch the drama program. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Open the bottle cap. Drink the water. Close the bottle cap. Put the bottle on the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote to turn off the TV. Stand up. Turn off the living room light. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading professional physiotherapy literature and doing online continuing education on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the study. Turn on the study light. Turn on the desk lamp. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Wait for the computer to start. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the web browser. Type the learning platform address. Log in to the course page. Click the video lesson. Put on the earphones. Watch the online lesson. Pause the video. Open the digital textbook file. Scroll down the page. Move the mouse to highlight a paragraph. Type notes in the document. Save the notes file. Click the next video lesson. Watch the lesson. Write down the exercise protocol in the notebook. Close the browser. Close the textbook file. Log out of the learning platform. Shut down the computer. Turn off the desk lamp. Turn off the study light. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Walk out of the study.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing lunch and snacks for the next workday and doing light tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese. Close the refrigerator door. Turn on the tap. Wash the lettuce and tomatoes under the water. Turn off the tap. Put the lettuce and tomatoes on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the tomatoes into slices. Put the lettuce and tomato slices into a lunch box. Put the cheese into the lunch box. Close the lunch box lid. Open the cabinet door. Take out a pack of biscuits. Put the biscuits into the bag. Close the cabinet door. Take out an apple from the fruit bowl. Put the apple into the bag. Put the lunch box into the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Night hygiene routine, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Rinse the face. Pick up the facial cleanser. Squeeze cleanser into the hand. Rub the cleanser over the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Put the toothbrush into the holder. Turn off the tap. Wipe the mouth with the towel. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with phone, then sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Turn on the bedroom light. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Sit down on the bed. Press the phone screen to unlock it. Open the message application. Reply to messages. Scroll through the news feed. Open the alarm application. Set the alarm to 06:30. Check the alarm is on. Lock the phone screen. Put the phone on the nightstand. Pick up the charger cable. Plug the cable into the phone. Plug the charger into the wall socket. Stand up. Turn off the bedroom light. Pull the blanket back. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close eyes. Turn onto the side. Keep lying on the bed. Sleep until the alarm rings.
